recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: spring fog pooling along the bay while daylight stretches past eight
dozens of public surplus doorways folded into a single search beam
house pulse and stutter-step bass under commuter fog
green contribution squares gone quiet, side projects in hibernation
headlines of weight and glass left outside; the week keeps its own weather

composer-2-fast.concept: You are fog: drag to thicken or thin visibility over a microscopic city; commuters (dots) only move when you clear a path, but clearing too fast spawns glare that blinds them.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Touch-drag to paint fog density; release to let tiny agents pathfind through your mist canopy.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Each 45s round ends with a sunrise score: how many dots reached warmth without getting lost.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Wind vectors appear, tearing your fog into streaks; more dots spawn from side streets.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: SF spring palette: slate fog, butter sun-edge, neon pinpricks for windows

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Beat-matched lane toy: three ribbon lanes stutter like a broken house track; tap to hop lanes so your spark lands on the downbeat, not the ghost note.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Rhythm lane switch with fake-out off-beats pulled from stutter-house timing.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Thirty-second drops—each flawless chain lengthens the bar into a shimmering bridge.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Phantom lanes shimmer and disappear; BPM micro-shifts shift hit windows by frames.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: Wireframe nightclub haze with chromatic afterimages

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: One-screen puzzle roguelite: sort surplus crate icons falling from an auction conveyor into labeled silos—but labels shuffle when the 'search beam' sweeps, forcing memory flips.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Flick crates left/center/right into bins; periodic label scramble via beam timer.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Every perfect wave unlocks a rarer 'odd lot' that scores big if you remember its last home.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Crates stack if mis-sorted; beam frequency increases; decoy icons appear.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Stamped paper cutout UI, rubber-stamp reds, kraft cardboard browns

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Physics flick garden: spring petals are actually tiny parachutes—flick them through fog rings to pollinate buds; wrong angle and they spiral into the drink.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Angled flick shot with soft-body drift and wind gusts.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Chain pollinations pop chromatic buds that reset the wind in your favor.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Fog thickens mid-round, shrinking rings; gusts cross-cut unpredictably.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Watercolor fog, ink-outline petals, pearlescent dew beads
